programme.title: Cultural Beliefs Around Weight Loss And Weight Gain - Kopano
programme.desc: What does 'healthy” really mean in 2025? In this episode of Don't Hold Back, host Nozibele Qamngana-Mayaba sits down with fitness coach Kopano Mokhele, who deliberately gained 25 kilos and is now losing it again so that he can understand what his clients go through. Together, they unpack the myths and realities of health in an age of body image pressure and quick-fix diets.

programme.desc: Terry takes himself out of “retirement” to test some scenes from RED that will be extremely dangerous. programme.title: E5 - More Texas Swine
programme.desc: Dead Meat 2022

programme.title: E6 - What's a Nilgai?
programme.desc: Leysath is joined by his son, Jake, for a unique experience chasing an invasive Asian antelope in south Texas. Nilgai are secretive and are usually spotted in the dark with infrared technology. Making it all happen is Corey Spriggs, aka The Hog Snyper, who is as passionate about hunting nilgai as he is about reducing the feral swine population of Texas. The meat is prepared a few different ways, including an incredible smoked whole hindquarter. The group also takes to the waters surrounding South Padre Island for some speckled trout.

programme.title: E7 - What's That Smell?
programme.desc: Leysath rejoins his Indiana pal, Cal Ditmar, a professional trapper. During his last visit, Leysath dared Ditmar to cook a skunk. Yes, a skunk. Not to back down from a challenge, Cal shows how it's done. They also take to the woods at night in search of coyotes and other night stalkers and talk to some seasoned trappers to learn more about why they do what they do. Not for the faint of heart or weak of stomach.

programme.title: E3 - Congo In Montreal
programme.desc: Helene meets Maria and Zoya, the mother-daughter duo behind Le Virunga, a pan-African restaurant in Montreal. Together, they take Helene to the heart of Africa by introducing her to a diverse, colorful, and gourmet cuisine.

programme.title: E19
programme.desc: A journey a world away from the usual tourist hotspots for an immersive visit to Overseas France. Men and women, each treasuring a deep attachment to their land, act as our guides for this unique exploration of Overseas France and all the wealth of its culture, environment and heritage.

programme.title: E17 - Rosa Kanno (Paris)/Sarah Levy (Brussels)
programme.desc: Rosa Kanno, eco-responsible stylist, creates made-to-measure clothing. Rejecting fast fashion, Rosa designs dresses using 3D modeling, which allows her to adjust creations to the clients' body shapes and limit fabric waste. A Franco-Belgian accessories designer, Sarah Levy creates hybrid pieces designed to free the body and adapt to contemporary movement. Committed to local and sustainable production, she works with Brussels workshops to refine her prototypes in leather and recycled nylon.

programme.title: E76 - Foie Gras-Stuffed Duck Necks In Villeneuve-Sur-Lot
programme.desc: Justine Piluso meets Carmen at the organic market in Villeneuve-sur-Lot. She also meets Yves, a duck farmer who takes her on a tour of his farm. On the menu: foie gras-stuffed duck necks served with braised cabbage.

programme.title: E207
programme.desc: An interactive programme that's as fun as it is informative and reactive to the meteorological events of the moment. Reports from the regions and special subjects in the studio offer an easy way to better understand the impact weather has on health, nature, history and everyday life.

programme.title: E13 - Val Piora
programme.desc: On board one of the steepest funiculars in the world, we reach Lake Ritom, a haven of biodiversity, then the shores of the mysterious Lake Cadagno, a centre of alpine biology that attracts researchers from all over the world. The day ends with a tasting of mountain cheeses and cured hams.

programme.title: Magic Cop
programme.desc: Lam, an experienced policeman, had his quiet and beautiful life in Tung Ping Chau. He often tackled criminal cases with his supernatural power. One day, the old lady living next door came to ask him to go Hong Kong Island to get back the dead body of her daughter, a stewardess who was killed by the police as being suspected to be a drug smuggler. Lam's niece, Lin, a young country girl, was very interested in the life of Hong Kong and decided to go with Lam. At the Police Station, Lam knew that the 'Stewardess' was killed by 2 police sergeants, Yin and Miu, after a desperate struggle. Lam explained that the 'Stewardess' had actually been killed before she came back to Hong Kong. She had been turned to be a living corpse and controlled by a Japanese magician for smuggling...

programme.title: Goodbye Mr. Cool
programme.desc: Ex-convict Dragon works as a waiter after his release from prison. He has no idea that he is now a father, until his six-year-old son greets him 'Dad' upon his release...

programme.title: Tiger Cage III
programme.desc: James and John are working in the Commercial Crime Bureau. Jointly they look into a case of which the suspect is an influential rich business man called Lee. James has a girl friend called Suki who is working for Wong, Lee's accountant. One night, in a party holding by Lee, John hears by chance the internal tips on a stock that Lee and his staff are talking about. John thus takes out all his saving and buys that stock. In the meantime, since Wong is murdered and James is also assaulted and seriously burnt, the case is closed under great pressure. On the other hand, the price of the stock which John has invested heavily slides. John is thus deeply depressed. Six months later, James has been much recovered under the care of two old men. At this time, Suki has climbed up to be a senior and important person in Wong's firm. Even Lee becomes a blocking stone in her eyes...

programme.title: Heaven Can Help
programme.desc: Mak born unlucky, he is driven to despair after a series of depressing events and got himself into a car accident. As he passed out, his spirit went to hell where the devils told him that he will die after the deaths of the Millionaire Wong, Ms. Pao and Mr. Shek. Soon Mak came to his senses. At the same time, a big bag is thrown at him from a passing car. Inside it is the dead body of Millionaire Wong. Mak went to warn Pao only to find her murdered. Mak tried to convince Shek by telling him about the deaths of Millionaire Wong and Pao but Shek didn't believe him. In total desperation, Mak turned to Shek's sister for help. At midnight, Shek had a meeting...

programme.title: E4 - 周杰倫吃瓜首輪競演
programme.desc: 由周杰倫擔當音樂造夢者，召集夢想生活官劉畊宏和夢想見證官王鶴棣，及四組廠牌經理人GAI周延&布瑞吉Bridge、歐陽靖&小鬼王琳凱、艾熱&早安、VaVa&盛宇，一同為說唱新生代們的追夢之旅保駕護航；打破傳統導師帶隊模式，通過構建真實師徒關系，共同打造獨具特色的說唱廠牌；透過競演激發說唱歌手創作才華，在全民中尋找下一個說唱巨星。

programme.title: E3 - 團魂燃燒 上演「速度與激情」
programme.desc: 一檔親子越野成長真人秀，六組親子家庭在寧夏開啟充滿挑戰和冒險的騎行之旅；胡軍擔任小小騎士訓練營發起人，任賢齊、李晨、于文文、武藝、涂松岩、符龍飛等嘉賓將與孩子們緊密合作，共同戰勝挑戰和難題，見證孩子們在騎行路上不斷前行、不斷成長的過程。

programme.title: E3 - 國醫少年團測試骨健康
programme.desc: 由陳妍希、夏之光、高卿塵、李雅娟組成國醫少年團，帶著對中醫文化的虔誠與需求，踏上制定的研學體驗地圖，遇見不同行醫風格的中醫師，與他們同吃同住，同苦同樂，深度體驗中醫藥從業者的工作艱辛，學習簡易上手的健康養生功法，從中體驗和領悟中醫藥的博大精深。

programme.title: E6 - 劉宇寧鎖定捆綁周深 (下)
programme.desc: 將繼續以「音樂牽線，緣分發聲」為主題，賽制上進行了全面創新升級，帶來更具懸念的緣分匹配設定、更多元的趣味互動模式，以及更動人的團隊默契考驗；匯聚周深、薛之謙、單依純等10位實力歌手與新銳音樂人，通過盲選歌單、即興創作等環碰撞靈感，打造專屬合作舞台！

programme.title: E76
programme.desc: 專為資深單身人士定制的相親交友節目，每集有4位男嘉賓和3位女嘉賓，依序進行一對一交流。未上場嘉賓則分別在男女嘉賓室觀察場上溝通情況，加深對有意對象的瞭解。節目主張為愛回歸，愛情不分年齡，緣來從來不晚。

programme.title: E2
programme.desc: 塗山紅紅與塗山雅雅、塗山容容，都是出生自苦情樹孕育出來的狐族，她們肩負著守護狐族的重任。紅紅作為狐族的領袖，擁有強大的妖力，帶領狐族結緣滋養苦情樹，苦情樹再守護狐族。然而一股黑暗的力量正試圖吞噬苦情樹，為了拯救它，只有完成天書任務才能守護苦情樹。

programme.title: E19
programme.desc: 從事心理健康指導工作的劉瑕路遇一名男子想要跳樓，劉瑕見狀便用心理學知識進行疏導，最後成功將該男子救下。這一幕恰巧被正想將自己的心理推理小說改編成劇本的作家祁連山目睹，便力邀劉瑕當顧問。為實現幫助更多人的理想，劉瑕成立了自己的工作室，以出色的專業水準和共情能力，為因事業、家庭或情感問題感到心理壓力的來訪者排憂解困，幫助他們恢復健康積極的生活。祁連山的小說在改編成影視劇的過程中得到了劉瑕的專業指導。隨著兩人接觸不斷加深，他深深地被劉瑕吸引。劉瑕工作之餘，與天才極客沈欽合作開發AI心理測試系統，並將之應用於兒童及社區公益，效果極佳。祁連山也逐漸參與到劉瑕的公益事業中，一起幫助那些面臨生活挑戰的人走出心理困境。二人在一次次攜手合作中越走越近，最終在各自事業都取得成功的同時，也收穫了美好的愛情。

programme.desc: 從事心理健康指導工作的劉瑕路遇一名男子想要跳樓，劉瑕見狀便用心理學知識進行疏導，最後成功將該男子救下。這一幕恰巧被正想將自己的心理推理小說改編成劇本的作家祁連山目睹，便力邀劉瑕當顧問。為實現幫助更多人的理想，劉瑕成立了自己的工作室，以出色的專業水準和共情能力，為因事業、家庭或情感問題感到心理壓力的來訪者排憂解困，幫助他們恢復健康積極的生活。祁連山的小說在改編成影視劇的過程中得到了劉瑕的專業指導。隨著兩人接觸不斷加深，他深深地被劉瑕吸引。劉瑕工作之餘，與天才極客沈欽合作開發AI心理測試系統，並將之應用於兒童及社區公益，效果極佳。祁連山也逐漸參與到劉瑕的公益事業中，一起幫助那些面臨生活挑戰的人走出心理困境。二人在一次次攜手合作中越走越近，最終在各自事業都取得成功的同時，也收穫了美好的愛情。
